home.how_subtitle: 4 simple steps to get your $50,000 USDT interest-free loan
home.step1_desc: Register with your email and basic details to get your unique deposit address.
home.step2_desc: Submit your ID, selfie, and proof of address for full identity verification.
home.step3_desc: Deposit and stake 500 USDT to activate your loan slot in the New Year Campaign.
home.step4_desc: Receive $50,000 USDT as a 10-year interest-free loan. Withdraw or trade freely.
home.features_subtitle: Security, speed, and your financial growth. All in one platform.
home.feat1_desc: 256-bit SSL encryption, 2FA, and cold storage for all assets.
home.feat2_desc: Up to 1.4M transactions per second on our matching engine.
home.feat3_desc: Available in over 100 countries with multi-language support.
home.feat4_desc: Full identity verification ensures a safe trading environment.
home.feat5_desc: Stake 500 USDT and receive $50,000 USDT as a 10-year interest-free loan.
home.feat6_desc: Join our growing community of traders worldwide.
home.faq1_q: How do I qualify for the $50,000 USDT loan?
home.faq1_a: Register an account, complete full KYC verification, and stake 500 USDT before December 31st, 2026. The first 1,000 users who complete all three steps receive the $50,000 USDT interest-free loan disbursed directly to their account.
home.faq2_a: Yes, 0% interest for the full 10-year term. The 500 USDT stake acts as a collateral deposit and is returned to you at the end of the loan period along with any profits you made trading.
home.faq3_q: Can I withdraw or trade with the loan funds?
home.faq3_a: Yes, once the $50,000 USDT loan is credited you can trade any spot pairs on the platform or withdraw the funds to your external TRC20 wallet at any time during the 10-year period.
home.faq4_q: What documents are required for KYC?
home.faq4_a: You need: (1) Valid government ID: passport, national ID, or driver's license, (2) A selfie/liveness check for face matching, and (3) Proof of address: utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months.
home.faq5_q: How long does KYC verification take?
home.faq5_a: KYC verification typically takes 24-48 hours. You'll receive an email notification when your status is updated.
home.faq6_q: When does the New Year Campaign end?
home.faq6_a: The campaign runs until December 31st, 2026. Spots are limited to 1,000 users on a first-come-first-served basis. After staking, the loan is disbursed to your account within 24 hours.
home.cta_desc: Only {count} spots remaining. Complete KYC + stake 500 USDT before December 31st, 2026.

campaign.faq1_q: When exactly is the loan disbursed?
campaign.faq1_a: The loan is disbursed on December 31, 2026 to users who have staked 500 USDT and maintained approved KYC status.
campaign.faq2_a: Yes, but unstaking before the deadline forfeits your position in the campaign and you will not receive the loan.
campaign.faq3_a: You can resubmit your KYC documents. Your stake is preserved even if KYC is rejected.
campaign.faq4_a: Yes, only 1,000 spots are available. The queue is first-come first-served based on staking order.
campaign.staked_eligible_badge: You Are Eligible for the $50,000 Loan
campaign.staked_eligible_desc: Your stake is active. Loan will be disbursed to your wallet on December 31, 2026.
campaign.unstaked_desc: Your 500 USDT was returned to your wallet. Loan eligibility was forfeited.
campaign.unstake_warning: Exiting permanently forfeits your $50,000 loan. Your 500 USDT will be returned. This cannot be undone.
campaign.exit_note: Exiting the campaign permanently forfeits your $50,000 loan eligibility. Your staked 500 USDT will be returned immediately.
campaign.stake_lock_note: 500 USDT locked until Dec 31, 2026 · Loan disbursed automatically
campaign.step1_full_sub: Upload government-issued ID + selfie. Reviewed within 24–48 hours.
campaign.step2_full_sub: Send USDT TRC20 to your personal deposit address on the Wallet page.
campaign.step3_full_sub: One click to lock your stake and secure your spot. Keep staked until Dec 31 to receive the loan.
campaign.step4_full_sub: Automatically credited to your wallet on December 31, 2026. Trade freely or withdraw anytime.
campaign.faq5_a: Yes. Every eligible user who maintains an active stake and passes KYC receives exactly $50,000 USDT credited to their GROXchange wallet on December 31, 2026.
campaign.faq6_q: Can I withdraw my staked 500 USDT before Dec 31?
campaign.faq6_a: Yes, you can exit the campaign at any time. Your 500 USDT is immediately returned to your wallet. However, unstaking permanently forfeits your $50,000 loan eligibility. You will not receive the loan.
campaign.faq7_q: Can I stake more than 500 USDT?
campaign.faq7_a: Yes, the maximum stake is 50,000 USDT. However, the loan amount is fixed at $50,000 USDT regardless of how much you stake. All eligible participants receive the same loan.
campaign.faq8_q: What if I don't complete KYC before Dec 31?
campaign.faq8_a: KYC must be approved before December 31, 2026 to receive the loan. Even if you've staked, the loan will not be disbursed without an approved KYC.
campaign.faq9_q: How do I withdraw the loan after disbursement?
campaign.faq9_a: After December 31, the $50,000 appears in your available balance. Go to Wallet → Withdraw, enter your TRON wallet address, and submit a withdrawal request. Standard 1 USDT network fee applies.
campaign.faq10_q: What is USDT TRC20? Can I send ERC20?
campaign.faq10_a: USDT TRC20 is Tether on the TRON blockchain. You MUST use TRC20. Sending ERC20 or BEP20 will result in permanent loss of funds. Always double-check the network before sending.
